what: Functions of default.xbe paired with their twins in the whole PC game (Scarface.exe 1.00.2), by portal/tools/pairing.py's method.
study_only: The accepted Scarface.exe has nine tenths of its code encrypted, so the PC side was read from a copy of the same build with the copy protection removed (same link time; not in the repository, and never a file a match is checked against: docs/GAME_VERSIONS.md). The PC function list is the one scarface-p3d (aap, MIT) publishes for that image. Use these pairs as leads: for what a function is, and for how its source was shaped. Only addresses, sizes and how each pair was found are here: no game bytes.
